title: The pushforward along a finite etale morphism preserves constructibility
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the pushforward along a finite etale morphism preserves constructibility, for sheaves of sets, of abelian groups and of modules over a Noetherian ring (statement lines 12320-12327). The proof reduces to the case of a finite locally constant sheaf through a partition of X (proof lines 12329-12334) and then pushes that partition down along the finite etale morphism, using that the pushforward is computed by the product over the fibres and hence preserves finite local constancy (proof lines 12334-12340). The non-formal content is the transport of the partition. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one computation over the fibres.
